title: Search Continues for 7 Missing Climbers After Pakistan Avalanche
summary_full: Three bodies, including that of an American climber, from a group of 10 were recovered a day after the avalanche struck on Thursday, officials said. The fate of renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja was still unclear.
